title: Analyze Environment
contents: property | Requires | Armor environmental protection or a field scientist’s kit
text | Travel at half speed or slower while checking your armor sensors or a held field scientist’s kit.
text | Automatically detect environmental hazards your armor protects against, including their severity: temperature, radiation, presence or absence of air, and similar conditions.
text | This is not a general scan for hidden traps, creatures, or every danger. Use Search or Seek for those.

title: Search
contents: text | Search for concealed hazards, secret doors, and hidden objects while usually traveling at half speed.

text | To check everything thoroughly, travel no faster than 300 feet/minute; to check before walking into danger, no faster than 150 feet/minute. Cluttered locations require stopping for a longer search.
text | When you encounter a hidden object or hazard, the GM makes a free secret Seek check to determine whether you notice it. Detection can require a minimum Perception proficiency.

title: Seek
contents: text | Choose an area to scan, normally no more than 30 feet in any dimension. The GM can adjust the area, impose distance penalties, or require extra actions for clutter.
text | The GM rolls secret Perception against hidden creatures’ Stealth DCs and objects’ detection DCs.
text | Critical success: Detected hidden or undetected creatures become observed; you locate objects.
text | Success: Undetected creatures become hidden; hidden creatures become observed. You locate an object or gain a clue to its whereabouts.
text | Limited senses or effects such as invisibility can prevent a creature from becoming observed.

title: Recall Knowledge
contents: property | Requires | A relevant skill; training not generally required
text | Suggest a relevant skill and ask the GM one specific question. The GM sets the DC and rolls secretly. You can discuss the question and skill before committing the action.
text | Critical success: A true answer, plus useful context or an answer to a follow-up question.
text | Success: A true answer. Failure: No useful answer. Critical failure: A false answer, or no answer at the GM’s discretion.
text | Examples: Piloting for vehicle parts; Crafting for engineering or tech creatures; Nature for beasts; a relevant Lore for its specialty. Ask about a weakness, a defense, or how something works.

title: Aid
contents: property | Requires | A willing ally; explain how you help
text | Prepare to help, usually by spending 1 action on your turn. The GM decides whether the method works and what check you roll.
text | Trigger: Your ally is about to make a skill check or attack roll. Use your reaction to roll the approved skill or attack, usually against DC 15.
text | Critical success: Ally gains +2 circumstance bonus to that check (+3 if you are master in the check; +4 if legendary).
text | Success: +1 circumstance bonus. Failure: No benefit. Critical failure: −1 circumstance penalty.
text | The GM can change the DC, preparation, traits, or permitted checks to suit the task.

title: Scout
contents: text | Watch for danger ahead of and behind the group while traveling at half speed.
text | At the next encounter, everyone in your party gains +1 circumstance bonus to initiative. Multiple Scouts do not stack this bonus.

title: Avoid Notice
contents: text | Attempt Stealth to travel unnoticed at half speed.
text | When an encounter starts, you usually roll Stealth for initiative. Compare that same result with enemies’ Perception DCs to determine whether they notice you, using the rules for Sneak.
text | Acting before someone in initiative does not by itself mean you are hidden from them.

title: Sense Motive
contents: text | Assess one creature’s behavior. The GM rolls secret Perception against its Deception DC or another relevant DC.
text | Critical success: Learn its true intentions and get a solid idea of mental magic affecting it.
text | Success: Tell whether it behaves normally, without learning exact intentions or magic.
text | Failure: Believe the deceptive impression it presents, or think a truthful creature behaves normally. Critical failure: Form a false impression of its intentions.
text | Normally you cannot retry against the same creature until the situation changes significantly. This is not automatic lie detection.

title: Take Cover
contents: property | Requires | Have cover, be near a suitable feature, or be prone
text | If you have standard cover, improve it to greater cover: +4 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex saves against area effects, and Stealth checks to Hide, Sneak, or avoid detection.
text | Otherwise gain standard cover, giving +2 instead.
text | Lasts until you move from your space, use an attack action, become unconscious, or end it as a free action. Cover must apply to the direction and situation of the attack.

title: Step
contents: property | Requires | Land Speed at least 10 feet
text | Move 5 feet without triggering reactions caused by movement or leaving or entering a square.
text | You cannot Step into difficult terrain or use a Speed other than your land Speed.
text | A useful way to reposition without an attack roll; it does not make you immune to all possible reactions.

title: Hero Points
contents: property | Requires | At least 1 Hero Point
text | Start each session with 1 Hero Point; hold at most 3. Unspent points expire at session end.
text | Reroll: Spend 1 point to reroll a check. You must use the second result. This is a fortune effect; you cannot spend multiple Hero Points on the same check.

text | Heroic recovery: When your dying condition would increase, spend all your points (minimum 1). Remove dying and stabilize at 0 HP. This does not add or increase wounded, but does not remove existing wounded.
